title: Egy megosztott évszázad (A Divided Century and a Half)
grammar: Long Periods: keresztül and -ig in History Texts

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can summarize the 150-year era of Hungarian partition from 1541 to 1699.
I can say that the allied armies retook Buda in 1686 and that the Peace of Karlowitz followed in 1699.
I can name what the three parts of Hungary still shared: language and legal tradition.
I can answer simple questions about the division of Hungary in the 16th and 17th centuries.
